Author: Shintaxo
Name: Keybind Profiles
Description: Experimental character-specific primary hotbar keybind profiles with preview and undo. WARNING: bindings may revert after logout or game restart; you may need to manually apply your desired profile again. The persistence fix is not yet verified in-game. Back up game settings before use. No automatic profile application or job switching. If a save/recovery error is pending, preserve the backup and inspect the error; do not repeatedly apply profiles.
Punchline: Experimental keybind profiles; may need reapplying after restart.
Changelog: 0.1.4: requests game keybind saving after apply/undo. Experimental: relog/restart persistence is not confirmed. If old bindings return, manually reapply the desired profile.
